lane: سُنْبُوقٌ _A small_ زَوْرَق [or _skiff_], (Sgh, K, TA,) _made on the coasts of the sea:_ a word of the dial. of the people of all the coasts of the Sea of El-Yemen: (Sgh, TA:) whether the ن be radical requires consideration: Sgh says, in the Tekmileh, that the word is of the measure فُنْعُولٌ, from السَّبْقُ. (TA.)
